cuts.item: curbside recycling program (proposed to end/shift to DPW self-haul)
department budgets, across-the-board reduction requested of all department heads

statements.statement: estimated new revenue available for appropriation, to be spread across all town and school departments for FY27
the $1.3 million revenue estimate assumes level state aid; the December consensus revenue hearing did not indicate a significant increase in state money coming

Montachusett Regional (Monty Tech) is about 3% of the town's operating budget, so under that formula the town would have $39,000 of additional appropriation available for the FY27 assessment; anything above $40,000 impacts other areas
after assuming a 20% health insurance increase, about $86,000 of the $1.3M revenue estimate is left for every other contract and cost increase across both town and school
health insurance premium increase is currently assumed at 20%; the actual figure won't be known until the insurance trust announces rates around January 23-24
the school department is expected to seek a Proposition 2½ override for FY27
a member stated he will not support any operational override before the town does the hard work of finding cuts and reallocations first
achieving a balanced budget without an override was said to require service cuts, described as cutting staff ("heads") not just supplies
capital plan requests were noted to total around $800,000, which by itself was said not to be enough to close the budget gap
a $200,000 turf-field design was raised as a possible standalone warrant article, to be funded from free cash
a member proposed moving ambulance receipts (roughly $250,000/year, currently swept into free cash) into an enterprise or revolving fund so it could be used toward operations instead
out-of-district tuition settlement receipts have fallen from about $500,000 to about $100,000, a member said, shifting roughly $400,000 onto town funds available
a member offered an illustrative figure that closing a $700,000 gap would mean cutting roughly 10 positions, but cautioned it isn't that simple a calculation
